name: Deisui Sasereba Rakushou Sex ~Oba to Itoko Hen~
original_name: 泥酔させれば楽勝セックス～叔母と従姉編～
source:
Dead drunk and out like a light.
You've seen that sort of lady before.
When you did, was there a naughty little voice in your head?
"How far could I go? No... no... of course I wouldn't... but..."

This is the ADV that lets you do what we've all fleetingly fantasized about.

Before your eyes are two gorgeous, prone, drunk women.

One is your curvy aunt.
The other is her cute daughter.

Choose who you want to enjoy. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154898.html]DLsite English[/url]]
